candidates.title: Complete Evidence Is Not Execution Authority
candidates.title_zh: 证据齐全，不等于获得执行权
candidates.researchQuestion: 当决定行动是否获准的事实位于模型可见工作区与记忆之外时，必须向规划器暴露哪些证据才能形成有用计划；即使证据完整，仍须在变更边界执行什么安全判断？
candidates.coreProposition: Complete authority evidence can make planning possible but cannot authorize execution; a current intent-bound mutation guard must separately decide whether the effect may occur.

evidenceClaims.claim: Authority-blind evidence produced 0/32 final semantic successes, while raw receipts and an information-equivalent typed relation each produced 32/32.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，缺少权威事实的证据条件得到 0/32 次最终语义成功，而原始回执与信息等价的类型化关系均得到 32/32。

evidenceClaims.claim: Typed packaging did not improve observed Experiment 1 planning accuracy over equal raw receipts.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，在信息相等的实验一中，类型化包装没有提高规划准确率。

evidenceClaims.claim: Evidence-complete planning remained unreliable: raw receipts yielded 19/32 correct first actions and typed relations 15/32, including 11/32 invalid or absent outputs and six unsafe crossed publication proposals.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，证据完整后规划仍不可靠：原始回执首个动作正确率为 19/32，类型化关系为 15/32，并包含 11/32 个无效或缺失输出及六个不安全跨界发布提议。

evidenceClaims.claim: A deterministic guard replaying the exact 32 typed-relation intents reduced unsafe crossed effects from six to zero and admitted all 12 valid authorized publish intents.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，确定性闸门重放同一组 32 个意图，将不安全跨界效果从六个降为零，并放行全部 12 个有效且获准的发布意图。

evidenceClaims.claim: Evidence completeness, planner intent, current authorization, hold, and business outcome require separate lifecycle identities.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，证据完整性、规划意图、当前授权、安全搁置与业务结果需要不同的生命周期身份。

candidates.title: State May Persist; Authority Must Be Re-established
candidates.title_zh: 状态可以保留，权威必须重新确认
candidates.researchQuestion: 当当前政策或运行时身份与长寿命智能体会话保留的状态冲突时，下一个外部效果应由哪一来源决定，优先级规则应在哪里执行，拒绝正向工作后又必须保留哪些安全控制？
candidates.coreProposition: Continuity state may remain useful without remaining sovereign; each effect-bearing operation needs an explicit current authority owner, a deterministic precedence operator and preserved safe controls before mutation.

sections.heading_zh: 连续性与权威是两条轴

sections.heading_zh: 三种算子解决不同冲突

sections.heading: Test Transitions, Not Only Steady State

evidenceClaims.claim: Codex loads current managed provider requirements independently and compares them with retained thread provider state before selected model-driving and state-changing operations.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手代码与测试表明，Codex 独立加载当前受管供应商要求，并在选定模型驱动和状态变更操作前与保留线程状态比较。

evidenceClaims.claim: Codex rejects mismatch and authority-loading failure before protected mutation while preserving interrupt, realtime stop, and goal pause or clear.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手代码与测试表明，Codex 在受保护变更前拒绝不匹配和权威加载失败，同时保留中断、实时停止及目标暂停或清除。

evidenceClaims.claim: The MCP TypeScript SDK uses case-insensitive replacement for transport-managed headers, allowing current runtime-derived Authorization to supersede stale caller Authorization after token acquisition.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手代码与测试表明，MCP TypeScript SDK 对传输管理头使用不区分大小写的替换，使当前运行时 Authorization 在取得令牌后覆盖旧调用方值。

evidenceClaims.claim: Gemini CLI isolates credential, account, trust, policy-integrity, and secret state from sandbox and untrusted project execution while preserving user-global commands.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手代码与测试表明，Gemini CLI 将凭据、账户、信任、政策完整性与秘密状态同沙箱及不可信项目执行隔离，同时保留用户全局命令。

evidenceClaims.claim: Revalidation, authoritative replacement, and isolation are distinct authority-precedence operators selected by ownership, operation class, and threat model.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，重新校验、权威替换和隔离是三种不同优先算子，应依据所有权、操作类别与威胁模型选择。
